invariant.portable_principle: A semantic-duplication proposal may act on exactly one confirmed structured finding only after kind, status, source, matrix, caller limitations, tests, stop condition, and human approval are explicit; preserving separate implementations is a valid success.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Retain the profile-scout and legacy triage path, while preserving unknown caller counts and writing scope metadata even from a selected-skill copy.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: A family-local Node JSON/filesystem consumer validates the accepted confirmed function finding and renders proposal.md, evidence.json, and scope.json without re-running analysis or changing source.
